rules: Assign all substantively changed policy topics; do not force one label.
A code citation, affected population, or institution alone is insufficient.
Keep affected sectors separate from direct topic labels; user-selected design.
Distinguish assigned, outside_taxonomy, needs_more_text, and pending.
Require exact input excerpts plus an explanation; excerpts alone do not prove relevance.
Do not infer policy direction, effectiveness, or enactment from category labels.
Ceremonial measures should be excluded from policy analysis even when they name a school, airport, or public official.
A sector-specific tax provision alone gets taxation plus an affected-sector tag. Add the sector as a policy topic only if a distinct substantive provision supports it.
